# Winterbourne Registry - archive windows

The catalogue keeps the open period of every accession as a duration string in the manifest, so that a
reader can reconstruct the window without knowing the date the catalogue was written.

turns.prompt: Winterbourne Registry records how long each accession stays open as a duration string in the ISO 8601 form, starting with the period designator and carrying each component with its own letter. Give the duration string for one hour and thirty minutes. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
